metadata.title: HYG v4.1 bright-star subset (V magnitude <= 4.5)
metadata.source: HYG Database v4.1, David Nash / Astronexus
metadata.attribution: HYG Database v4.1, David Nash / Astronexus; compiled from Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star and Gliese catalogs
notes: Modified subset: excludes Sol, keeps stars with catalog V magnitude <= 4.5, converts RA hours to degrees, trims and renames fields, sorts by apparent magnitude.
This derived data file remains CC BY-SA 4.0. Share adapted catalog data under the same license; retain attribution and indicate modifications.
Coordinates are catalog J2000 directions without current-date precession, aberration or proper-motion propagation. Brightness is a catalog value, not live photometry.
